title: Sales starter
description: CRM, prospecting and meeting tools, plus prompts for account research, outreach emails, call follow-ups, objection handling and meeting prep.

apps.name: Account research
apps.prompt: Research {{ask: Company? | the company on this page}}: what they do, size, news from the last 6 months, likely priorities, the roles that usually decide on a purchase like ours, and 3 conversation openers.

apps.name: Prospect email
apps.prompt: Write a short first email to the person on this profile: a personal hook from their profile, the problem we solve, one proof point and a soft ask. Under 120 words, with 2 subject lines. Open it as a draft in my mail app.

apps.name: Follow-up after a call
apps.prompt:
Turn these call notes into a follow-up email: a recap of their needs, what we agreed, next steps with dates and anything we promised to send. Open it as a draft.

{{selection}}

apps.name: Handle an objection
apps.prompt: The prospect said: {{ask: What was the objection?}} Give 3 ways to respond (acknowledge, ask a question, share evidence), with example wording for each.

apps.name: Meeting prep
apps.prompt: Prepare me for a meeting with {{ask: Who, and which company?}}: background, recent news, likely goals, good questions to ask, and risks. Keep it to one page.

apps.name: Log the call in CRM
apps.prompt: Fill the CRM form on this page with the details from this call: {{ask: Call summary?}} Show me what you will enter before saving anything.

apps.name: Competitor compare
apps.prompt: Compare us with the competitor on this page: features, pricing, target customer, strengths and weaknesses, and talk tracks for when a prospect mentions them.
